name: C1 completed study verification
description: Existing Loop verifies completed isolated GameStore study artifacts. No gameplay execution, promotion or repairs.

nodes.title: study-audit
command: import sys,json,hashlib; from pathlib import Path; sys.path.insert(0,'Tools/ChaosCrew'); import c1; r=Path.cwd(); e=r/'Documentation/ChaosCrew/C1/Evidence'; assert c1.manifest(r)==c1.read(e/'source-manifest.json'); s=c1.read(e/'study-summary.json'); assert s['launchScenarios']==100 and s['fuzzScenarios']==100; [(c1.audit(c1.read(e/(k+'.json'))), c1.sha((e/(k+'.json')).read_bytes())==v or (_ for _ in ()).throw(ValueError(k))) for k,v in s['replayFingerprints'].items()]; c1.validate_candidate(c1.read(r/'FailureLedger/candidates/CF-c1-ca78b88c9c0e.json'),r); print('PASS: source, 200 replay hashes, public allowlist and F1 candidate')

nodes.title: Review C1 evidence before logical acceptance
nodes.instructions: Review C1 report and candidate. This gate does not promote F1 findings or authorize gameplay changes.

nodes.title: Logical acceptance of C1 verification evidence only
